title: Mystic Alchemist in Study
description: A woman with blue and purple braided hair wearing an ornate golden headdress and white robes stands at a wooden table performing magic. She holds green smoke in her hands while surrounded by alchemical tools, scrolls, potion bottles, scales, an open book, and hanging glass orbs in a warmly lit study with mystical paintings on the walls.
prompt: A mystical female alchemist with intricate blue and purple braids and a golden swirling headdress stands in her study, conjuring green magical smoke between her hands. She wears flowing white robes. The wooden table before her is covered with scrolls, an open spellbook, scales, glowing potion bottles, and a bowl of golden runes. Colorful glass orbs hang from the ceiling. Behind her is a large colorful painting of a serpent and flames. Warm light streams through an arched window, creating an atmosphere of arcane study and magic.
